claim_ceiling: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings (center-projected) are a validated COMPLEMENTARY representation mode for Swiss Federal Supreme Court decisions at 21-24yr scale (137k-158k decisions), providing: (1) citation heritage recovery superior to TF-IDF (AUC 0.77-0.85 vs 0.71-0.74), (2) section-specific cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings (not reasoning), (3) linear hybrid complement passing adversarial gates at 19yr+ but remaining below TF-IDF jurist preference baseline. Primary product mode remains TF-IDF citation hybrids. 174k completion blocked on corpus dependencies.
